vis.scope: Existing MeasurementSet or current calibration table.

mode.scope: List, save, restore, delete or rename.

comment.scope: Snapshot comment for save and rename.

merge.scope: Replace, OR, or AND flags during restore.

behaviors.title: Manage persisted flag versions
behaviors.scope: Create, list, rename, delete and restore CASA-readable snapshots. Preserve a calibration table’s FLAG-only schema and its stored science data.
behaviors.gap: Further shared version parameter and error-domain behavior is tracked under #978 and #1617.

calibration-versions.scope: CASA-written complex bandpass and real delay tables, with flag versions produced and restored through both public Python implementations.
calibration-versions.result: Four calibration version workflows, 24 replace/OR/AND restores, four renamed restores and four missing-version cases passed. A live casacore writer and a failed stage verified read-lock consistency and retry. Other calibration columns and metadata were preserved.
